description.value: Known locally as 'The Boh,' Bohemian Cafe & Catering Co. has been an Okanagan brunch institution on Kelowna's main Bernard Avenue since 1991, drawing a loyal following for its hearty breakfast and brunch fare in a family-friendly atmosphere with outdoor patio seating. The business also operates a catering arm serving private and corporate events across the region. Its central downtown Kelowna location makes it a natural morning fuel stop for cyclists passing through the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bohemiancater.com corroborates the OSM address (524 Bernard Avenue, Kelowna BC V1Y 6P1) and supplies a phone number (250-862-3517) absent from OSM tags; the front page and catering-menu subpage confirm an active, established brunch and catering operation open daily. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. A significant concern is that the /menu/ subpage has been domain-hijacked and now serves an unrelated Indonesian gambling site (Luxury138), suggesting partial domain compromise.
concerns: The /menu/ subpage (bohemiancater.com/menu/) has been hijacked and now serves an unrelated Indonesian gambling/slot site (Luxury138), indicating partial domain or subdirectory compromise — the cafe's own menu is therefore inaccessible and unverifiable from the website.
Phone number 250-862-3517 is present on the website but absent from OSM tags; OSM should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established, well-reviewed brunch cafe in a prime central Kelowna location on Bernard Avenue; a touring cyclist would clearly benefit from this listing as a morning meal stop.

wow_evidence: Okanagan brunch institution on Kelowna's main Bernard Avenue since 1991
